module purpose: neorv32_cpu_icc is a CSR-accessed inter-core link: a CSR write with csr_addr_i = csr_mxiccdata_c passes csr_wdata_i into the queue sub-unit tx_queue_inst, whose outputs drive the transmit record icc_tx_o (dat, rdy) and whose re_i is driven by the peer acknowledge icc_rx_i.ack; CSR reads return the received word icc_rx_i.dat or a status word (icc_rx_i.rdy, tx_fifo_free) on csr_rdata_o, and a CSR read of csr_mxiccdata_c raises icc_tx_o.ack.

use-case flows.value: enqueue request: a CSR write (csr_we_i) with csr_addr_i = csr_mxiccdata_c raises tx_fifo_we, passed to the queue sub-unit's we_i
outgoing message word: csr_wdata_i passed into tx_queue_inst (wdata_i); the sub-unit's rdata_o and avail_o drive icc_tx_o.dat and icc_tx_o.rdy, and the peer acknowledge icc_rx_i.ack drives its re_i
incoming message word icc_rx_i.dat returned on csr_rdata_o when csr_addr_i(11 downto 1) matches csr_mxiccsreg_c, csr_addr_i(0) = '1' and icc_rx_i.rdy = '1'; zero otherwise
status word: bit 0 = icc_rx_i.rdy, bit 1 = tx_fifo_free (the queue's free_o), returned when csr_addr_i(0) = '0'
receive acknowledge to the peer: icc_tx_o.ack = '1' on a CSR read (csr_re_i) with csr_addr_i = csr_mxiccdata_c

conceptual assets.concept: Outgoing inter-core message word -- the data word the CPU writes for the peer and that the link presents on its transmit side
conceptual assets.reasoning: The send flow passes the written word into the queue sub-unit with `wdata_i => csr_wdata_i,` (line 81; csr_wdata_i occurrence 2, CONNECTS tx_queue_inst.wdata_i, mode in), qualified by `we_i => tx_fifo_we,` (line 82), and the word the sub-unit presents leaves on `rdata_o => icc_tx_o.dat,` (line 86; field icc_tx_o.dat CONNECTS tx_queue_inst.rdata_o, mode out). Both consumers (tx_queue_inst, whose internals are not supplied, and the receiver of icc_tx_o) lie outside this entity, so Integrity is Established from lines 81 and 86: the queue must receive exactly the written word and the receiver exactly the word the queue delivers. csr_wdata_i sets the word: it is where the value enters this entity. icc_tx_o is the exit port, named whole (occurrence 3 at line 86, with its dat field's connection as the edge). The icc_t record has only dat, rdy and ack: one data word with a ready flag and an acknowledge, no address or byte enables, so it is treated as a point-to-point data link, not a transport record. Whether and how long the word is held is inside tx_queue_inst (generics at lines 67-71) and is not inferred. No line restricts who observes icc_tx_o, so confidentiality is not established.

conceptual assets.concept: Transmit-enqueue decision -- whether a CSR access pushes the written word into the transmit queue
conceptual assets.reasoning: `tx_fifo_we <= '1' when (csr_we_i = '1') and (csr_addr_i = csr_mxiccdata_c) else '0';` (line 60) computes the decision (tx_fifo_we occurrence 2, GATED_BY csr_we_i and csr_addr_i) and `we_i => tx_fifo_we,` (line 82, CONNECTS tx_queue_inst.we_i, mode in) delivers it to the sub-unit. Integrity is Established: the enqueue decision must hold exactly when the write strobe and the address predicate of line 60 hold, and the sub-unit must receive exactly that decision (line 82). csr_we_i (GATES tx_fifo_we, occurrence 2) and csr_addr_i (GATES tx_fifo_we, occurrence 6) set it, since this entity reads both to decide. csr_mxiccdata_c is a package constant: evidence, not a candidate.

conceptual assets.concept: Receive-acknowledge event -- the acknowledge this side raises toward the peer when the CPU reads the ICC data address
conceptual assets.reasoning: `icc_tx_o.ack <= '1' when (csr_re_i = '1') and (csr_addr_i = csr_mxiccdata_c) else '0';` (line 59) computes the event in this entity (field icc_tx_o.ack, handling ORIGINATES, GATED_BY csr_re_i and csr_addr_i) and drives it out through icc_tx_o. Its receiver lies outside this entity, so Integrity is Established from line 59: the receiver must see exactly this read-strobe and address predicate. csr_re_i (GATES icc_tx_o.ack, occurrence 2) and csr_addr_i (GATES icc_tx_o.ack, occurrence 5) set it. icc_tx_o is the exit port, named whole (occurrence 2 at line 59, with its ack field's GATED_BY record as the edge); the event has no internal signal of its own.

conceptual assets.concept: Received inter-core message word -- the peer's data word returned to the CPU on a CSR read
conceptual assets.reasoning: The read-out flow drives `csr_rdata_o <= icc_rx_i.dat;` (line 52) only inside `if (icc_rx_i.rdy = '1') then` (line 51), when csr_addr_i(11 downto 1) matches csr_mxiccsreg_c and csr_addr_i(0) is not '0' (lines 46-47); otherwise the default `csr_rdata_o <= (others => '0');` (line 45) holds. The requester lies outside this entity, so Integrity is Established from lines 45-52: it must receive exactly icc_rx_i.dat under those conditions and zero otherwise. csr_rdata_o is the exit port (COPIES icc_rx_i.dat, occurrence 5). icc_rx_i, named whole, sets the concept because this entity reads its rdy field to decide whether the word is presented (GATES csr_rdata_o, occurrence 4, line 51); its dat field is only copied (handling FORWARDS). csr_addr_i selects which register is returned but does not carry the word, so it is not listed here. No line restricts who issues the read, so confidentiality is not established.

conceptual assets.concept: Link status -- the incoming-word-ready flag and the transmit-queue-free flag reported to the CPU
conceptual assets.reasoning: When csr_addr_i(11 downto 1) matches csr_mxiccsreg_c and csr_addr_i(0) = '0' (lines 46-47), `csr_rdata_o(0) <= icc_rx_i.rdy;` (line 48) and `csr_rdata_o(1) <= tx_fifo_free;` (line 49) report the two flags. tx_fifo_free carries the value the sub-unit produces (`free_o => tx_fifo_free,` line 83; CONNECTS tx_queue_inst.free_o, mode out, occurrence 4), so it computes the free flag in this entity under the sub-unit-output rule. icc_rx_i sets the ready flag (field rdy CARRIES csr_rdata_o, occurrence 3, line 48), and the same rdy value decides the data read-out at line 51, so it is not only forwarded. csr_rdata_o is the exit port (COPIES tx_fifo_free, occurrence 4). The requester lies outside this entity, so Integrity is Established from lines 48-49: the reported bits must equal the received ready flag and the queue's free output.

conceptual assets.concept: Transmit handshake -- the availability flag of the outgoing word presented to the peer and the peer's acknowledge that the queue receives
conceptual assets.reasoning: `avail_o => icc_tx_o.rdy` (line 87) drives the transmit side's ready flag from the queue sub-unit, and `re_i => icc_rx_i.ack,` (line 85) passes the peer's acknowledge into the queue. Both values cross this entity between tx_queue_inst and the link, and their users lie outside it, so Integrity is Established from lines 85 and 87: the receiver must see exactly the queue's availability output, and the queue exactly the received acknowledge. icc_tx_o is the exit port (occurrence 4 at line 87, edge of its rdy field: CONNECTS tx_queue_inst.avail_o, mode out). icc_rx_i sets the acknowledge passed into the sub-unit (occurrence 6 at line 85, edge of its ack field: CONNECTS tx_queue_inst.re_i, mode in). What the queue does with re_i is not inferred. clk_i and rstn_i are wired to the sub-unit's clock and reset ports (lines 75-76) and are never reported.
